title: The World’s Most Powerful Government Is Targeting This Man for Pro-Palestine Speech
author: Team Zeteo
content:
In one of the Trump administration's earliest crackdowns on free speech at
universities, masked agents arrested a Georgetown scholar from India, father
of three, and legal U.S. resident. **Badar Khan Suri** was
[accused](https://x.com/TriciaOhio/status/1902524674291966261?s=20) of
"actively spreading Hamas propaganda and promoting antisemitism on social
media" after he [criticized](https://thehoya.com/news/news-top/on-social-
media-khan-suri-opposed-israeli-action-did-not-advocate-breaking-law/)
Israel's assault on Gaza online. ICE held him for two months, and Secretary of
State Marco Rubio [personally
sought](https://www.supremecourt.gov/DocketPDF/26/26-380/424997/20260921121357872_Trump%20v.%20Suri.pdf)
to deport him, before a federal judge ordered his
[release](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-georgetown-scholar-badar).

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Now, the government is once again moving to
[deport](https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/trump-administration-asks-supreme-
court-detain-badar-khan-suri-again) Suri - in a case that could set a major
precedent for whether the U.S. can weaponize immigration enforcement to punish
speech. Suri sits down with **Mehdi** to tell his story.

**" I was metamorphosed into a subhuman Amazon package without any tag on me,"
**Suri says of his [brutal detention](https://zeteo.com/p/going-through-hell-
badar-khan-suri). He was transferred from facility to facility, across
multiple states, without notice to his wife and children.

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/the-worlds-most-powerful-
government?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

Suri and Mehdi also discuss his costly legal battle, how he became a **"
scapegoat"** for his Palestinian-American wife, and the genocide in Gaza.

But despite everything he has endured, Suri refuses to give up hope:

**" Hopelessness is a crime,"** he tells Mehdi. **" Democracy is going down
the hill, but we can still save it. And if we cannot save it here, where can
we save it?"**
